title: Pixel Pet Arena
desc: Paint a pixel pet, train its colour stats, choose abilities, and battle through a friendly arena league.

title: Beat Builder Battle
desc: Compose beat patterns, battle rhythm rivals, hit timing goals, unlock sounds, and save your best Arcade score.

title: Creature Rescue Clinic
desc: Run a cozy creature clinic by reading symptoms, choosing treatments, upgrading rooms, and keeping patients calm.

title: Marble Run Lab
desc: Rotate route tiles, trace the marble path, fix leaks and guide the marble from start to goal across staged logic labs.

title: Backpack Quest
desc: Choose map nodes, fight room enemies, pack loot, trigger relic synergies, and chase a better six-room run score.

title: Mini Theme Park Builder
desc: Build a tiny park across five days with budget choices, guest joy, queue pressure, weather events, star ratings and Arcade best-score saves.

title: Lumo's Garden Defense
desc: Plant sunflowers, sprouts and frost buds, harvest sunlight and hold back the garden pests across 10 waves , then chase high scores in Endless Mode.

title: Bubble Pop Galaxy
desc: A cosmic collapse puzzle. Pop groups, trigger cascades, hit level targets and spawn bombs before your moves run out.

title: Neon Tiles: Beat Builder
desc: Tap falling tiles across four lanes, nail the timing for perfects, chain combos, dodge traps and climb the levels.

title: Pip’s Bakery Planner
desc: Bake, hire staff and buy upgrades. Catch golden croissants, earn while away, then franchise for permanent bonuses.

title: Paper Toss: Wind Lab
desc: A physics estimation challenge: read wind and distance, adjust throw angle and force, then learn from each miss across 20 levels.

title: Echo's Flight
desc: Choose flight equipment, explore three currents and combine abilities across an expedition. Every eight gates brings a new route decision.

title: Pastry Match: Bakery Orders
desc: Memorise pastry positions, match pairs in the recipe order, spend focus on pins or board glances, and complete bakery orders efficiently.

title: Dough Dash
desc: Match pastries to stock your pantry, choose bakery orders and serve six tickets before your moves run out. Leftovers shape your next decision.

title: Star Chef: Recipe Queue
desc: Serve hungry customers fast and earn big tips. Build your 5-star restaurant reputation!

title: Bread Blocks
desc: Place bakery blocks with a mission target in mind: clear rows, build baskets, and practise spatial planning under pressure.

title: Lumo's Firefly Shooter
desc: Shoot coloured fireflies to make matches and clear the board. Special bubbles, power-ups, and satisfying chain drops.

title: PiP's Star Connect
desc: Tap the stars in order to draw constellations in the night sky, just like PiP!

title: Arcane Citadel
desc: Place towers, cast spells, and survive endless enemy waves. Chain lightning, a roguelite shop, and a minimap.

title: Gem Match
desc: Two-minute match-3 with bombs, wilds, fever mode, cascading combos, and a global leaderboard.

title: VoidRush: Navigation Lab
desc: Pilot your ship through neon deep space, collect fuel, and outrun the Void Entity before it swallows you whole.

title: Crypt Crawlers
desc: Descend into the crypt, battle monsters, and find your way out. A browser-based dungeon crawler in pure JavaScript.

title: Tiger Smash: Angle Lab
desc: A brick-breaker about angles and rebound planning: aim shots, clear themed stages, collect coins, and choose useful paddle upgrades.

title: Dungeon Delve: Map Logic
desc: Explore procedurally generated dungeons, collect loot, and survive as long as you can.

title: Little Steps: Choice Trail
desc: A cosmic runner about small choices: read the path ahead, choose safer lanes, collect sparks, and keep the journey going one step at a time.

title: Stardust Constellation Rescue
desc: Read constellation symbol patterns, collect the correct stardust in order, dodge hazards, and restore each sky map.

title: Critter Whack: Ranger Sort
desc: Read habitat clues, tap the matching critters, avoid hazards, and build streaks in a quick sorting-and-attention game.

title: Lumo Dash: Pattern Trail
desc: Run with Lumo through readable obstacle patterns, choosing when to jump or slide while building focus and timing.

title: Nibble Quest: Route Planner
desc: A cosy snake quest about route planning: collect food, manage a growing trail, use power fruit, and avoid trapping yourself.

title: Stack Attack
desc: Answer quick maths and symmetry prompts, choose the right block width, then balance the tower to reach the beacon.

title: Echo's Fruit Catch: Rainbow Picnic
desc: A gentle early-years sorting game: catch the requested fruit, avoid rocks, and practise left-right movement with forgiving controls.

title: Call of the Cards: Quest for the Crown
desc: A browser playtest of the tabletop card game: recruit companions, manage gold, cycle your deck, complete quests and race to 5 VP.

title: Candy Kingdom Adventure Online
desc: A guided online version of the kids tabletop RPG: choose a candy hero, read GM scenes, roll a d6, and play through the first adventure.

title: Biscuit Tin Clicker
desc: Cosy clicker , tap biscuits, buy upgrades and fill your tin. Idle earnings while away.

title: Cozy Cafe Match
desc: Cozy match-3 puzzle game. Match pastries, serve customers and build your cafe.

title: Cozy Creatures: The Ultimate Snuggle
desc: Gentle kids game , snuggle, play and explore with cozy creatures. Ages 3-8.

title: Quiz Quest
desc: Millionaire-style trivia quiz. Answer questions, climb the ladder and win the crown.

title: Sky High With Friends
desc: Multiplayer sky-high adventure. Bounce, climb and race friends to the top.
